quests.title: A Boy's Dream
quests.requirements: Giant Shell Bug Odontotyrannus [Key Item] Knight's boots
interactions: Speak with Ailbeche.
Return to and speak with Ailbeche again.
Trade Ailbeche a Giant Shell Bug . Either buy one off the Auction House, or go to Crawler's Nest and defeat Dreadbug via the ??? on map 2, SW of H-9.
You can fish up Odontotyrannus (Monster) before trading Ailbeche the Giant Shell Bug in the previous step.
Return Ailbeche and trade them the Odontotyrannus .

quests.title: Father and Son
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Talk to Ailbeche to start the quest for a cutscene.
Ailbeche's father, Exoroche, can be found in Southern San d'Oria at (K-7) in Helbort's Blade.

Return to Ailbeche and talk to him again for a cutscene. You'll receive the willow fishing rod as reward. In order to active the Paladin AF1 quest, Sharpening the Sword, it's necessary to trade back the fishing rod to Ailbeche. Doing so will also change your title to Family Counselor.

quests.title: Sharpening the Sword
quests.requirements: [Key Item] Ordelle whetstone
interactions: In order to start this quest, it's necessary to trade back the fishing rod to Ailbeche from the previous quest Father and Son.
Speak with Ailbeche near Home Point #2 to begin the quest. He will ask you for an Ordelle whetstone.
Return to Ailbeche to end the quest and receive your reward.

quests.title: Under Oath
quests.requirements: Zvahl Coffer Key [Key Item] Mique's paintbrush [Key Item] Strange sheet of paper
interactions: Speak to Ailbeche, Northern San d'Oria (J-9).
You may additionally talk to Ailbeche, Exoroche, and Vemalpeau for more quest-related dialogue. Vemalpeau will take your Knight's confession key item.

quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Then make your way to the Manustery in Windurst Woods, Speak to Apururu who is at (H-9). You may need to talk to her twice if you have a [Key Item] Windurst Trust permit as she will mention talking to her brother, Ajido-Marujido.

Alternatively, you can use any means of leaving the zone that will not lead you to East Sarutabaruta. Doing this will allow you to skip the cutscene and go straight back to Apururu will which lead to a slightly different cutscene upon finishing the Mission.
Head back to the Manustery and speak to Apururu to complete the Mission.

quests.title: Class Reunion
quests.requirements: Ice Pendulum Astragalos ×4
interactions: While your main job is Summoner, interact with the House of the Hero in Windurst Walls for a cutscene with Carbuncle. He will give you a [Key Item] Carbuncle's Tear.

Next: Speak to Koru-Moru in Windurst Walls at (E-7). He will ask for four Astragaloi. Astragalos may be purchased at the Bonecrafting Guild in Windurst Woods from Shih Tayuun, but is only restocked if players NPC it to the guild.

quests.title: I Can Hear a Rainbow
quests.requirements: Carbuncle's Ruby
interactions: Obtain a Carbuncle's Ruby from a Leech mob. Poison Leeches in Buburimu Peninsula are possibly the easiest ones to drop Rubies.

Next: Alternatively, Bloodsuckers in Toraimarai Canal may have the highest drop rate. However, the area is difficult to get to for newer players, and there are only two spawns - at H-9 and J-9 on Map 1.

You will be instructed to experience 7 types of weather in outdoor areas. It seems only zones available in or before the Rise of Zilart Expansion will work. Note: The Carbuncle's Ruby must be in your inventory to receive the weather cutscene. You also can't simply idle in a zone - you must zone into an area while the weather is occuring to get the scene.
Next: Western / Eastern Altepa Desert (Rare, available all year)
If you drop Carbuncle's Ruby before completing the quest, you do NOT lose progress; simply obtain another one.

quests.title: The Puppet Master
quests.requirements: Earth Pendulum
interactions: While you are on Summoner as a main job, interact with the House of the Hero in Windurst Walls (Home Point #1) to speak to Carbuncle.

quests.title: Recollections
quests.requirements: Bag of Seeds Whine Cellar Key [Key Item] "Foe Finder Mk. I"
interactions: Begin quest by speaking with Chumimi, found in the basement of Heavens Tower (Windurst). There is an optional cutscene in Ru'Lude Gardens with Laityn (G-9), if you wish to learn more about the story.

After speaking with Chumimi, head to the basement of Crawlers' Nest and obtain a Bag of Seeds drop from either a Fire Elemental or Water Elemental. It is strongly recommended to check with Appollonia in Upper Jeuno (G-6) for weather in Rolanberry Fields as it is shared with Crawlers' Nest as the elementals only appear during weather.
Next: Elementals will pop in the "donut room" on Map 3 with the Strange Apparatus.
Return to Chumimi and trade her the Bag of Seeds.
Return to Chumimi after the cutscene in the Keep, and following another short sequence, the quest is completed and you'll obtain BLM AF1 Feet, Wizard's Sabots.

quests.title: The Root of the Problem
quests.requirements: Silk Cloth [Key Item] "Sluice Surveyor Mk. I"
interactions: Begin quest by speaking with Chumimi as Black Mage in the basement of Heavens Tower. Zoning out of the tower is required after finishing the previous quest.
Return to Chumimi afterwards to recieve the [Key Item] "Sluice Surveyor Mk. I".
Return to Chumimi for the final cutscene and your reward.

quests.title: The Three Magi
quests.requirements: Faded Crystal
interactions: Begin the quest by speaking with Chumimi, found in the basement of Heavens Tower (Windurst). You must be on Black Mage to start this quest.
After speaking with Chumimi, head to any Telepoint and trade a synthesis crystal to receive a Faded Crystal .
Next: Travel to Xarcabard and head toward (E-8)
Take the Glowstone that drops from the NM and return to Chumimi. She will give you the Casting Wand in return.

quests.title: Breaking Barriers
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak with Curilla and Rahal for small talk about the previous Mission. They will also have different dialogue after the KIs are obtained but before the Mission is completed.

quests.title: Enveloped in Darkness
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: After completing The Crimson Trial and attaining level 50+ Red Mage, speak to Curilla (I-9) in Chateau d'Oraguille. You will receive the Old pocket watch. You no longer have to be on RDM after starting the quest.
Next: Players from San d'Oria must be rank 2, but players from other nations must be on at least Bastok / Windurst Mission 2-3 and able the enter Chateau d'Oraguille.
Speak to Curilla again.

On Map 2 at (I-10) examine the ???. A dialog will ask if you want to bury the [Key Item] Old boots and [Key Item] Crawler blood, of course you do. If you get a message "Someone has been digging here" you have forgotten to talk to Curilla after trading the velvet cloth.

quests.title: Old Wounds
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speaking with Curilla will grant you the [Key Item] Weapon training guide as well as the Sapara of Trials . You will need to break the latent on the Sapara of Trials before completing the rest of the Quest.
Trade the Sapara of Trials back to Curilla. This will give you the [Key Item] Map to the Annals of Truth.

Next: You will be instructed to travel to Quicksand Caves. Before you go, you will need to speak to Lokpix in Eastern Altepa Desert at (G-7) and complete the Quest Open Sesame to acquire the [Key Item] Loadstone. This allows you to use the weight-activated switches without needing multiple people.
Go back and speak with Curilla to receive your reward.

quests.title: Peace for the Spirit
quests.requirements: Antique Coin Nail Puller
interactions: As a Red Mage, Talk to Curilla in Chateau d'Oraguille at (I-9) to start this quest. Note: You don't have to be RDM for the remainder of this quest.

quests.title: The General's Secret
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Curilla and agree to help her to receive [Key Item] Curilla's bottle.
Next: Head to Horlais Peak by going through Yughott Grotto.

Once in Horlais Peak, head to the Hot Springs in the springs and check it to get [Key Item] Curilla's bottle again. To confirm you filled it, because the name doesn't change, observe the text description of the item under "Temporary Items". It should read "The bottle from general Curilla. It is full of water from the hot spring that flows from the Horlais Peak"
Return to Curilla for your reward.

Return to Gulmama with the whisper and she will provide several reward options including the ability to summon Shiva.

quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.

quests.title: On My Way
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speak to Gumbah in Bastok Mines in the house next to home point #3 @ (J-7) (go up the stairs to second floor and cross the bridge) for a cutscene which will complete the Mission. If the Gate Guard says you have orders to deliver the [Key Item] Letter from Werei, speak to Gumbah again and make sure you see the cutscene where he reads the letter.
Gumbah may go through various cutscenes before getting to the letter, be sure to keep clicking him until he gets to verbiage that is consistently the same and does not change.
Gumbah prioritizes The Voracious Resurgence Missions if they're active. If it's for the epilogue quest, you'll need to zone before talking to him again.

quests.title: Blade of Darkness
quests.requirements: Chaosbringer
interactions: Speak with Gumbah. He is located on the upper floor in Bastok Mines inside the house at J-7.

quests.title: Blade of Death
quests.requirements: Letter from Zeid Chaosbringer
interactions: Speak to Gumbah to receive the key item Letter from Zeid.

Next: Use the Chaosbringer to slay 100 more enemies. If you discarded your Chaosbringer , take the boat from Palborough Mines to Zeruhn Mines to receive a new one from Zeid. This will reset the blade, meaning that you will have to kill a total of 200 monsters with the blade in order to complete the quest.

quests.title: Inheritance
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speaking with Gumbah will grant you the key item Weapon training guide as well as the Sword of Trials. You will need to break the latent on the Sword of Trials before completing the rest of the quest. Breaking the Latent
Trade the Sword of Trials back to Gumbah. This will give you the key item Map to the Annals of Truth.
Next: Next, travel to the oasis in Western Altepa Desert at (E-9). It is located in the south west of the map. Via Survival Guide, Unity Warp (125), or Voidwatch warps.
Go back and speak with Gumbah to receive your reward.

quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speaking with Iron Eater will grant you the key item Weapon training guide as well as the Axe of Trials. You will need to break the latent on the Axe of Trials before completing the rest of the quest. Breaking the Latent

Next: Alternatively, for the fastest route, use the Unity Warp to Ro'Maeve (level 125), then zone into The Sanctuary of Zi'Tah. The ??? is located at (F-5) in the southwest area.
Go back and speak with Iron Eater to receive your reward.

quests.title: Awakening of the Gods
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Talk to Leepe-Hoppe on the roof of the Rhinostery, located in the southern half of Windurst Waters near Home Point #3. The correct dialogue involves Rukususu and Kerutoto.
The correct cutscene is the one where she talks about Leepe-Hoppe and Rukususu, not the Diabolos one.
Return to Leepe-Hoppe to complete the Mission.

quests.title: The Price of Peace
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Then make your way to the roof of the Rhinostery in Windurst Waters (J-8) (near Home Point #3), it is located in the southern half of the zone. Speak with Leepe-Hoppe at (J-9) on the roof of the Rhinostery. He will give you the [Key Item] Food offering and [Key Item] Drink offering.
Next: Head out for Giddeus, which is located at (F-8) in West Sarutabaruta. If you previously unlocked it, you can teleport directly to (G-12) with Home Point #1 and make your way north from there.

quests.title: The Moonlit Path
quests.requirements: Whisper of flames Whisper of frost Whisper of gales Whisper of storms Whisper of tides Whisper of tremors
interactions: Talk to Leepe-Hoppe to begin the quest. If the quest Tuning In is offered (cutscene with Shikaree Y), simply zone and talk to Leepe-Hoppe again to get the proper cutscene. Assuming you have the proper fame.
Turn the whispers into Leepe-Hoppe to receive a Moon bauble.

Next: Head to Full Moon Fountain. Preferably, home point to Toraimarai Canal #1. If you don't have it yet, make sure to grab it on the way. Otherwise, the Survival Guide can be used to warp to Toraimarai Canal if you have it.
Return to Leepe-Hoppe to turn in the whisper for your reward.

quests.title: Tuning In
quests.requirements: Extra-Fine File Spruce Lumber Magicked Steel
interactions: Speak with Leepe-Hoppe to start the quest.

Leepe-Hoppe requires 3 items, all of which must be farmed from Chains of Promathia areas. An Extra-Fine File can be found by defeating Fomor in Lufaise Meadows. Specifically, Fomor Warrior, Fomor Monk, Fomor Dark Knight, Fomor Paladin, and Fomor Samurai.
You need to trade all 3 of these items to Leepe-Hoppe at once to complete the quest. Speak to Leepe-Hoppe again to start the Tuning Out quest.

quests.title: Tuning Out
quests.requirements: Habaneros Black Curry Mutton Tortilla
interactions: Speak to Leepe-Hoppe to initiate the quest, you must wait one earth minute from completing Tuning In.
Speaking to Leepe-Hoppe - Windurst Waters - Home Point 3 - after completing the quest will reward you with a Cache-nez

quests.title: A Testing Time
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Head to (L-6) in Windurst Waters and speak to Moreno-Toeno (inside the Aurastery), who gives you the [Key Item] "Creature Counter" magic doll to keep track of your objective. (Optional): You can talk to the students on the roof and the other NPCs in the same room as Moreno-Toeno for additional dialogue.
Next: You can save some time by setting your Home Point in Windurst Waters and bringing a Warp item.
Head to Tahrongi Canyon and start killing monsters. You have exactly 24 game hours (1 Earth time hour) to kill at least 30 monsters in the Canyon and return to Moreno-Toeno.
Upon defeating 30 monsters, return to Moreno-Toeno.
Head to Buburimu Peninsula and start killing monsters. You have exactly 48 game hours (2 Earth time hours) to kill at least 30 monsters in the Peninsula and return to Moreno-Toeno.

quests.title: Vain
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Talk to Moreno-Toeno in Windurst Waters (L-6) at the Aurastery (northern section, eastern building, HP#2 is closest) for a cutscene and to obtain the [Key Item] "Star Seeker".

Next: Click the Qu'Hau Spring in Ro'Maeve (H-6) for a cutscene. Quick travel options: the Survival Guide to Ro'Maeve is the fastest way. The Voidwatch warp to Hall of the Gods or Ro'Maeve are the next best options, respectively.
Return to Moreno-Toeno for a cutscene that completes the Mission. Optional: Talk to Moreno-Toeno again.

quests.title: Teacher's Pet
quests.requirements: Bird Feather Two-Leaf Mandragora Bud.
interactions: Speak to Moreno-Toeno in the east Aurastery (North Map) to begin the quest. You will be requested to collect and trade in a Bird Feather and Two-Leaf Mandragora Bud . You may need to speak with them twice.

quests.title: Lost for Words
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Head to (J-3) in Windurst Woods and speak to Nanaa Mihgo. She will lend you her [Key Item] Lapis monocle. You may need to talk to her twice or more if you have a [Key Item] Windurst Trust permit and Aht Urhgan Lure of the Wildcat Quests started.
Make your way back to Nanaa Mihgo, who will give you the [Key Item] Hideout key. (Optional): Nanaa's cronies have new additional dialogue.
Next: Inner Horutoto Ruins:

quests.title: As Thick as Thieves
quests.requirements: Multiples may be needed. Gausebit Grass Rock Salt Lizard Egg
interactions: Speak to Nanaa Mihgo in Windurst Woods (J-3) to begin. She'll mention the last signature on the [Key Item] signed envelope was a single letter and ask you what it was. The multiple choice answers are:
Speak to Cha Lebagta and Bopa Greso who are just south of Nanaa Mihgo at J-4 for a couple clues you will need.
Head back to Windurst Woods and speak to Nanaa Mihgo again to get your Rogue's Bonnet!

quests.title: Hitting the Marquisate
quests.requirements: Quake Grenade ×4 Pickaxe
interactions: Speak to Nanaa Mihgo in Windurst Woods (J-3) to receive the [Key Item] Cat Burglar's note.
Next: Go to Lower Jeuno (G-10) and speak to Yatniel on the top floor. He will ask for 4x Quake Grenades.
Head to Windurst Woods and talk to Nanaa Mihgo. She will ask what letter was on your papers. The correct answer is "Blank," but any response will progress the quest.

quests.title: Mihgo's Amigo
quests.requirements: 4x Yagudo Necklaces
interactions: Speak to Nanaa Mihgo multiple times till the Quest is flagged. If done as a level 40+ Thief, it will potentially begin the Quests The Tenshodo Showdown (THF AF 1), As Thick as Thieves (THF AF 2) and/or Hitting the Marquisate (THF AF 3). You will need to finish these first to flag this Quest.
Trade Nanaa Mihgo the Necklaces to complete the Quest.

quests.title: Rock Racketeer
quests.requirements: [Key Item] Sharp gray stone Sharp Stone
interactions: Speak to Nanaa Mihgo to receive a [Key Item] Sharp gray stone.
Next: Speak to Ardea, Bastok Markets (H-8)HP#4 and sell the Stone to her for 10 Gil.
Return to Nanaa Mihgo.

quests.title: The Tenshodo Showdown
quests.requirements: Quadav Stew
interactions: Talk to Nanaa Mihgo as a Thief to begin this quest, and she will give you a [Key Item] Letter from the Tenshodo. You must have the Tenshodo Membership to continue with this quest.
Next: Head to Lower Jeuno and talk to Harnek inside of the Tenshodo at (J-7) for a cutscene.

name: Pakh Jatalfih

quests.title: A New Journey
quests.requirements: You will receive the Letter to the ambassador key item during the mission. To use the Delkfutt shortcut you need either the physical Delkfutt Key or the permanent Delkfutt key key item. If you have neither, Porphyrion on the 10th floor provides the key needed to reach the basement.
interactions: Travel to Ru'Lude Gardens and speak with Pakh Jatalfih at the Windurstian Embassy (I-9). Make sure you receive his mission cutscene before going to Delkfutt's Tower.
Next: Travel to Lower Delkfutt's Tower . A Survival Guide teleport is the quickest route if you have it unlocked.

At (L-7) , examine the Cermet Door . This is the mission door and should trigger the required cutscene. If you do not receive a cutscene, verify that you are at the L-7 basement door and that you completed the Windurst Embassy cutscene with Pakh Jatalfih.
Next: After the L-7 cutscene, return to Ru'Lude Gardens (I-9) and enter the Windurstian Embassy. Speak with Pakh Jatalfih so he acknowledges your return.
After the L-7 cutscene, return to Ru'Lude Gardens (I-9) and enter the Windurstian Embassy. Speak with Pakh Jatalfih so he acknowledges your return.

quests.title: Magicite
quests.requirements: Rank 4 and enough Rank Points to flag Magicite. [Key Item] Tenshodo Member's Card — needed later to enter Tenshodo HQ and reach Aldo. Additional key items are obtained during the mission for the Davoi, Castle Oztroja, and Beadeaux magicite routes.
interactions: Flag Magicite at the Windurstian Embassy. In Ru'Lude Gardens , go to the Windurstian Embassy at (I-9) and speak with Pakh Jatalfih . If he does not advance the mission, check that A New Journey is complete, you are Rank 4, and your Rank Points are high enough.

Return to Pakh Jatalfih — this is the actual mission completion. Go back to the Windurstian Embassy in Ru'Lude Gardens (I-9) and speak with Pakh Jatalfih . Complete his final Magicite cutscene/dialogue. This is where Magicite completes and you receive Rank 5 and 10,000 Gil. After your rank changes to Rank 5, Magicite is finished and you can proceed to The Final Seal .

quests.title: Fire and Brimstone
quests.requirements: Old Earring
interactions: Talk to Perih Vashai in Windurst Woods (K-7) and she will tell you to go to Mhaura and visit the Blacksmiths' guild.
After the cutscene head back to Windurst Woods and speak with Perih Vashai again.
You will get another cutscene with the Mithran Tracker, where you are told by Perih Vashai to head to Castle Oztroja to search a pool for an Old Earring .
Take the Old Earring and trade it to Perih Vashai for a cutscene and the Hunter's Beret.

quests.title: From Saplings Grow
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Speaking with Perih Vashai will grant you the key item Weapons Training Guide as well as the Bow of Trials. You will need to break the latent on the Bow of Trials before completing the rest of the quest. Breaking the Latent
Trade the Bow of Trials back to Perih Vashai. This will give you the key item Map to the Annals of Truth. You will be instructed to travel to Cape Teriggan.

Next: Take Silent Oil and Prism Powder with you and head to Kuftal Tunnel. Travel to (I-7) and north through the tunnel. Continue north; take no branches. At (I-4) the tunnel will loop down southward into a larger space, and you will need to curve immediately back up to the northwest. Exit Kuftal Tunnel into Cape Teriggan. Faster traveling options:
Go back and speak with Perih Vashai to receive your reward.

quests.title: The Fanged One
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.

Just talk to her repeatedly until her dialogue is related instead to this quest.
Return to Perih Vashai to complete the quest.

quests.title: Unbridled Passion
quests.requirements: [Key Item] Koh's letter Gold Earring

Head back to Windurst Woods and talk once more to Perih Vashai for the final cutscene and your reward.

quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: You'll be instructed to go see Prince Trion. Visit him in his room at (H-7) in Chateau d'Oraguille

When defeated, check the Heavy Stone Door again, and enter. Check the Tombstone inside for a cutscene, at the end of which, you'll receive the [Key Item] Ancient San d'Orian book. (Optional): Return to Prince Trion, and you will be instructed to go see the Gate Guard.
Next: Talk to any Gate Guard. A cutscene will play out saying they sent the book to scholars to decipher.
Zone and talk to the Guard again who will tell you to see Prince Trion.
Return to Prince Trion and speak with him for a cutscene. You may need to talk to him twice.

quests.title: The Heir to the Light
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Part Two will include Prince Trion fighting by your side, against 3 Orc NMs, Warlord Rojgnoj (PLD unsleepable), Rojgnoj's Left Hand (BLM), and Rojgnoj's Right Hand (DRK). Trion will randomly attack a mob, and should be helped. Preferably, the order to kill the NMs is BLM > PLD > DRK. Trion can be cured and can die in the BC. Should he die, you will be ejected from the BC. Despite being a Paladin, he isn't great at keeping himself alive.

quests.title: Under Oath
quests.requirements: Zvahl Coffer Key [Key Item] Mique's paintbrush [Key Item] Strange sheet of paper
interactions: Finally, head back to Chateau d'Oraguille and speak to Prince Trion for your reward.

quests.title: Flyers for Regine
quests.requirements: Magicmart Flyer ×15
interactions: Speak with Regine to begin quest and choose the option to look for work.

While this quest is active, if you come close to an NPC you need to give a flyer to, a message will appear in /say informing you that "... looks over curiously for a moment." What happens if you drop the fliers? You must hand out 15 fliers or the quest wont be completed. If you somehow lose the fliers, you may purchase additional fliers from Regine at the cost of 10gil per flier. Trade her 10gil each time to receive 1 flier, which is the max she will trade you at one time. You can also buy the fliers at the Auction House.
Next: Travel to the following zones and trade the fliers to the following NPCs: Port San d'Oria
Once all 15 Magicmart Flyers have been distributed, return to Regine and speak with her to end quest.

interactions: Speak to Shantotto (K-7) who will ask you a few questions. Choose the second option to the first question, "Ask if you're worthy."
Choose the second option to the next question, "Whatchu talkin' 'bout Shantotto?"
Head to the tower at (I-7) in Beaucedine Glacier, speak to Torino-Samarino, speak to him again and choose the first option to receive [Key Item] Shantotto's new spell.
Next: Head to Fei'Yin. In the basement (Map 2) at (F-6), check the north-western Cermet Door to get a cutscene with Rukususu. Using the Home Point #2 to Fei'Yin is the fastest way.

Note: Be careful of how many monsters you kill in Fei'Yin. If you kill too many monsters while in posession of [Key Item] Shantotto's new spell before turning it in to Rukususu, the item will break and be replaced by [Key Item] Shantotto's ex-spell. If this happens, return to Torino-Samarino to retrieve another scroll.

quests.title: Lost for Words
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Head for the Optistery on the northern map of Windurst Waters (near Home Point #1). Speak to Tosuka-Porika at (G-8) (East door). (Optional): The other NPCs and Tosuka-Porika inside the same room have additional dialogue.
Make your way back to Windurst Waters Home Point #1 and speak to Tosuka-Porika to complete the Mission. (Optional): Some of the NPCs in the same room have new additional dialogue.

quests.title: The Jester Who'd Be King
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Tosuka-Porika in Windurst Waters North HP #1, inside the eastern Optistery building.
(Optional) Return to Tosuka-Porika to report about the Book of the Gods as promised.

quests.title: The Sixth Ministry
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Talk to Tosuka-Porika in the Optistery eastern building in Windurst Waters HP #1 (G-8) for a cutscene and to receive the [Key Item] Optistery ring.

Next: Head to Toraimarai Canal (G-8) Map 2 and defeat the 4 Hinge Oils in the room. Quickest way to get there is to enter through the Windurst Walls (I-3) Priming Gate using the [Key Item] Rhinostery certificate, take a right at the bottom of the stairs, get into the water and keep turning left until you reach some stairs, which you should go up. From here, head south → east → north to reach the Slimes in (G-8).
Return to Tosuka-Porika to complete the Mission. You will receive the [Key Item] Blank Book of the Gods.

quests.title: Chasing Tales

quests.title: Early Bird Catches the Bookworm

Furakku-Norakku will give you the [Key Item] Overdue book notification to be delivered to Orn. Orn is located at F-10 in the Rarab Tail Hostelry room above the Timbre Timbers Tavern.
Next: (Optional) You can speak to Furakku-Norakku again at Orn's request.

quests.title: Hat in Hand

interactions: Tosuka-Porika in the east Optistery building (G-8) (North Map).

quests.title: Darkness Rising
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Go to Fei'Yin (located in the northeast corner of Beaucedine Glacier) for a cutscene with Zeid. You will have to reach the Qu'Bia Arena and clear the BCNM "The Rank 5 Mission". The majority of enemies in Fei'Yin detect by sound, however there are several that detect spellcasting.

quests.title: The Chains That Bind Us
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: After the fight, interact with the Galka Statue for a cutscene with Zeid.
Navigate through the Map 5-6 weighted doors to the mural room at (H-8) for a second cutscene with Zeid.

quests.title: Where Two Paths Converge
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: You'll be facing a two-part fight against Zeid.
HP is shared between Part 1 and Part 2, with it being impossible to one-shot Zeid in Part 1. It is, however, possible to nuke him to 1% HP and then kill him before he swings in the next round.

Zeid can use an AoE WS that has a Sleep effect, so consider using Poison Potions. At around 65% health, you will get a small cutscene and Volker will now join your fight. You will need to keep him alive, should he fall, you will fail and be ejected from the BC.

Zeid will now be able to summon 2 mobs called Shadow of Rage. They have a decent attack, but low HP. They are immune to Sleep, so don't bother. Let the tank take all of them, and focus your damage on Zeid himself. Zeid will resummon them if they are defeated.
Zeid CAN Skillchain with his Shadows, so be careful. Use your 2HRs if necessary, the fight isn't too difficult.

quests.title: The Ruins of Fei'Yin
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Go to Fei'Yin (located in the northeast corner of Beaucedine Glacier) for a cutscene with Zeid. You will have to reach the Qu'Bia Arena and clear the BCNM "The Rank 5 Mission". The majority of enemies in Fei'Yin detect by sound, however there are several that detect spellcasting.

quests.title: The Final Seal
quests.requirements: No advance item requirement is listed.
interactions: Go to Fei'Yin (located in the northeast corner of Beaucedine Glacier) for a cutscene with Zeid. You will have to reach the Qu'Bia Arena and clear the BCNM "The Rank 5 Mission". The majority of enemies in Fei'Yin detect by sound, however there are several that detect spellcasting.

quests.title: Blade of Darkness
quests.requirements: Chaosbringer
interactions: Speak to him repeatedly until you get the cutscene that begins the quest. It specifically mentions finding Zeid so he can teach you how to become a Dark Knight. It can be difficult to get the correct cutscene. There are situations where you receive the same dialogue no matter how many times you speak to them. Try zoning if this happens.

Next: Travel to the Palborough Mines and go to the top floor (Map 3). Home Point #1 is on the southern end of this map and you can make your way back north to near the top of the map, then proceed south again.
Go to the Boat Docks at (H-8), climb aboard one of the boats, and then interact with the Dock Lever for a cutscene with Zeid. Ensure you have a free space in your inventory.

quests.title: Blade of Death
quests.requirements: Letter from Zeid Chaosbringer
interactions: Speak to Gumbah to receive the key item Letter from Zeid.

Next: Use the Chaosbringer to slay 100 more enemies. If you discarded your Chaosbringer , take the boat from Palborough Mines to Zeruhn Mines to receive a new one from Zeid. This will reset the blade, meaning that you will have to kill a total of 200 monsters with the blade in order to complete the quest.
